source.version: Published ACM CHI ’25 proceedings version, April 26–May 01, 2025, Yokohama; DOI 10.1145/3706598.3713886; 17 pages (PDF p. 1). The supplied PDF ends with references and publication-history dates; no appendix is included.

studies.label: Main experiment: dyad AUT with or without ChatGPT-4, followed by unaided immediate and individual retention post-tests
studies.cluster_se_treatment: Dyads were randomly assigned (PDF p. 5, Section 4.2.2). The reported analyzed cluster counts come from Section 4.3. No standard errors, cluster-adjusted model, or explicit treatment of dyad clustering are reported. Mann-Whitney U tests are described (PDF p. 7, Section 4.5.1); the elaboration test statistics conflict with a conventional test over the stated dyad counts. The actual test unit needs clarification.

counts_source.quote: The valid sample consisted of 52 dyads/104 participants, with 26 dyads/52 participants per experimental condition.

arms.name: Experimental AI group
arms.description: Dyads could freely prompt off-the-shelf ChatGPT-4 through the task interface during the main AUT. Direct copy-paste from the chat to the answer box was disabled. AI was removed for both post-tests (PDF pp. 5-6, Sections 4.2.2-4.2.4).

arms.name: Control non-AI group
arms.description: Dyads performed the same main AUT in the same interface without AI and then completed the same unaided post-tests (PDF pp. 5-6, Sections 4.2.2-4.2.4).

studies.task: Computer Science students generated alternate uses collaboratively for a fork, flower pot, and suitcase, then unaided in dyads for a glass bottle, and individually online for a key, brick, and gymnastics ball in the retention test (PDF pp. 5-6, Sections 4.2.1-4.2.4).

ai_tool.name: ChatGPT-4 (off-the-shelf, used as is without research-team prompt engineering)
ai_tool.locator: PDF p. 4, Section 3; PDF p. 5, Section 4.2.2. The model release year is not stated. Reference [80] on PDF p. 16 names gpt-4, version March 2024, but is cited for ChatGPT generally and does not establish the exact experimental model version or its release year.

preregistration.where: AsPredicted, https://aspredicted.org/msym-tbc2.pdf (PDF p. 4, Section 3; the paper also states that hypotheses were preregistered in PDF p. 13, Section 6.4). Direct retrieval failed because network sockets were denied.
preregistration.primary_outcome: Flexibility and originality in the main, immediate, and retention tests are the outcomes named in hypotheses H1-H3 (PDF p. 4, Section 3). Primary coding follows these preregistered hypothesis outcomes, as in the screening form; the registration itself and any explicit primary/secondary ranking could not be verified.

open_items: The main-test and immediate-post-test elaboration U statistics do not establish valid dyad-level inference. Confirm the actual test rows, statistic convention, and treatment of dyad clustering, and obtain uncertainty at the randomized-dyad level (PDF pp. 7-9, Sections 4.5.1, 5.1.1, and 5.1.2).

For immediate-post-test fluency, the paper prints arm SDs but does not explicitly state the rows over which they were calculated. Confirm whether they describe independent dyad scores, duplicated participant rows, or another level before standardization or uncertainty calculation (PDF p. 9, Section 5.1.2).

Confirm retention analyzed people, attrition, and whether individual scores or dyad averages entered the reported comparison; the procedure and figure labels conflict (PDF p. 5, Figure 1; PDF p. 6, Section 4.2.4; PDF p. 10, Figure 12).

Counts randomized before the German-language inclusion rule and counts excluded are not printed. The recorded sample and cluster counts are analyzed counts, not verified randomized counts (PDF pp. 5-6, Sections 4.2.1-4.3).

Obtain full-sample numeric arm means outside the figures and missing dispersion, tests, and uncertainty for the remaining AUT contrasts. No figure-only values, subgroup SDs, or inferred p-value bounds were transcribed (PDF pp. 8-10, Sections 5.1.1-5.1.3).

Supplementary Materials are referenced for scoring and other study details but were not supplied or found under the paper identifiers in the local literature folder. Direct ACM supplementary-page retrieval was denied by network socket permissions; its statistical coverage remains unknown (PDF pp. 5-7 and 10).

The paper identifies preregistered flexibility and originality hypotheses, but the linked AsPredicted PDF could not be retrieved because network sockets were denied. Verify any explicit primary-outcome ranking against that registration (PDF p. 4, Section 3; PDF p. 13, Section 6.4).
Individual coder identities and coding reliability are not printed in the main text; the supplement is only described as containing detailed AUT scoring (PDF p. 7, Sections 4.5.1-4.5.2).
The retention test is described as unaided, but prevention or checking of AI use and results of the interim AI-use questionnaire are not reported (PDF pp. 5-6, Sections 4.2 and 4.2.4).

The exact experimental ChatGPT-4 version and model release year are not established. A bibliographic reference to a model-documentation version is not treated as the model release year (PDF p. 4, Section 3; PDF p. 16, reference [80]).
notes: Extractor A, 2026-10-09. Read the entire supplied markdown from beginning through the end of the references; there are no appendices in this version. All cited PDF pages were text-extracted with pymupdf. The result paragraphs and the conflicting retention figure labels were also visually checked through in-memory PDF rendering, without creating image files. Mathematical labels U, p, mean, and sd in the numerical source quotes were restored from the rendered PDF because text extraction returns replacement characters; numbers retain their printed precision. Quotes otherwise use the PDF text with line breaks collapsed and soft hyphens removed. All eligible full-sample outcome contrasts are retained, even when only a qualitative comparison is extractable; numerical values available only in figures remain null. No effect sizes, differences, uncertainty, counts, or unit conversions were computed. The listed studies contain the eligible randomized experiment only; the summarized AI-versus-human pre-study is listed under not_extracted. No shared sample is identified for the main experiment in the paper or screening form. Repeated post-tests remain in the same randomized study; they are not randomized-order crossover contrasts. Originality measures output rarity and is coded novelty, so this paper supplies no across_people estimate. se_basis=not_reported reflects absent or unresolved eligible uncertainty, rather than an assumption that the reported U tests used independent dyads.
